SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Ungasayina imiyalezo ngeedilesi zakho ukuze ubonise ukuba ungumnini wazo. Lumka ungasayini nantoni na engacacanga, njengoko uhlaselo lwe-phishing lunokuzama ukukukhohlisa ukuba usayine ubuwena bakho kubo. Sayina kuphela iingxelo ezineenkcukacha ezipheleleyo ovumelana nazo.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Faka idilesi yokusayina, umyalezo (qinisekisa ukuba ukopa imigca ephukileyo, izithuba, iithebhu, njl.njl.) kunye notyikityo olungezantsi ukuqinisekisa umyalezo. Lumka ungafundi okungakumbi kutyikityo kunoko kukwimyalezo osayiniweyo, ukuze uphephe ukukhohliswa luhlaselo lomntu ophakathi.

REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: Le miyalelo yokulungisa ayinakusebenza xa iMetrix Core isebenza ngaphandle
REPAIR.INFO: Amaqhosha angasezantsi aza kuqalisa kwakhona iMetrix Core ngokukhetha umgca womyalelo ukulungisa isipaji, ukulungisa iingxaki zeefayile ze-blockchain ezonakeleyo okanye iintengiselwano ezingekhoyo/eziphelelwe lixesha.
REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Inzame yokufumana izitshixo zabucala kwi-wallet eyonakeleyo.dat.
REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -scan: Skena kwakhona i-blockchain ukuze ubone ukuba akukho zintengiselwano zewallet.
REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Buyisela iintengiselwano kwi-blockchain (gcina i-meta-data, umz. umnini-akhawunti)
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -upgradewallet: Phucula iwallet ibe yifomathi yamva nje xa uqala. (Qaphela: olu AKULONA uhlaziyo lwewallet ngokwayo!)
REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Yakha kwakhona isalathisi se-blockchain kwiifayile ze-blk000??.dat zangoku.
REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Ukukhuphela iifayile zeMetrix blockchain kwi-metrixcoin.com kunye nokuqalisa ukufakela kwakho. Ngokuxhomekeke kuqhagamshelo lwenethiwekhi yakho oku kunokuthatha imizuzu eli-10 ukuya kwiiyure ezimbalwa.
REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Cima iifayile zakho ze-blockchain zasekuhlaleni uze uphinde uvumelanise kwi-genesis block.
REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Qala kwakhona iMetrix Core ukuba sele isebenza okanye uqalise iMetrix Core ukuba ayisebenzi.
REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Cima iMetrix Core yakho yasekuhlaleni uze uyifake kwakhona kwiiseva zeMetrix.

Ngenxa yezizathu zokhuseleko, iikopi zangaphambili zefayile yesipaji engafihliweyo aziyi kusetyenziswa kwangoko nje ukuba uqale ukusebenzisa isipaji esitsha, esifihliweyo.

GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Abalawuli banoxanduva lokuvota kwiibhajethi zenyanga kunye notshintsho lwe-blockchain. Ungaba yiRhuluneli ngokufaka isibambiso esichanekileyo kwikhontrakthi yoLawulo.
GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: Uza kubhalisa njengoRhuluneli. Oku kuza kuthumela intengiselwano enesibambiso esifunekayo kwikhontrakthi yolawulo. Ungaphuma nanini na ubhalise.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Abalawuli banoxanduva lokuvota kwiibhajethi zenyanga kunye notshintsho lwe-blockchain.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: Ukuze uhlale unguRhuluneli kuya kufuneka uthathe inxaxheba kwivoti enye ubuncinane rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezingama-30.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: Ukuba akukho nto yokuvota ungaqhubeka nokubhalisa kwakho ngesandla ngokuthumela i-ping esebenzayo.
GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAIL: Imeko yakho yobhaliso lweRhuluneli iya kubonakala xa i-blockchain yakho ihambelana ngokupheleleyo.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: I-blockchain yeMetrix ifuduselwa kwi-DGP. Kuya kufuneka uphume kwisivumelwano se-DGP esidala uze uphinde ubhalise kwisivumelwano esitsha. Ukuba uneRhuluneli endala, uya kubona kuphela iqhosha lokukhupha ubhaliso kweli phepha.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: Ubhaliso olutsha lwe-DGP luya kwenzeka xa sele kusebenze i-onchain. I-discord yethu iya kuba nolwazi lwamva nje ngale nto.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: Iqhosha elingezantsi liza kukhupha inguqulelo yakho endala yeGovernor kwaye libuyisele isibambiso sakho.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Nje ukuba ukukhutshwa kwakho kugqityiwe olu khetho luya kunyamalala.
